_README: Explicit symbol -> CIK overrides for the intelligence ingestion service. Add an entry ONLY when the SEC company_tickers.json file is missing a ticker or maps it wrongly (e.g. a recent ticker change). Each entry: {"cik": "0000000000", "company_name": "...", "note": "why this override exists + date"}. This map wins over the SEC file. Never add a fuzzy/ambiguous mapping here. Symbols that simply do not file 8-K/10-Q/10-K belong in ServiceConfig.KNOWN_NON_FILERS, not here.
